envelope.description: Implement private immutable storage and durable journal

body.title: Implement private immutable storage and durable journal
body.summary: Add recovery-journal.ts under project/.insrc/review-runs/investigation-v1/<runId> with bounded canonical immutable blobs, no-overwrite installation, file/directory sync and framed hash-chained events. Bind all writes to trusted process guard and root-scoped serialized store registry.
acceptanceChecks: 0700 directories/0600 files; traversal, symlink and cross-run reference escape refused.
Blob durability precedes event references and event fsync precedes successful append acknowledgment; fail injection yields no false success.
Event ordinal separate from accepted-block sequence; malformed complete frames fail closed; torn final frame handled only under exclusive owner.

tests.name: Private run paths, canonical immutable values and symlink escape refusal
Blob-before-event durability and append sync fault matrix
